description: This file defines a NestJS controller for managing team-related API endpoints, including creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting teams.

classes.name: TeamsController
classes.description: NestJS controller handling team management API endpoints such as create, get, update, and delete teams.

methods.name: createTeam
methods.description: Creates a new team, returning success status and team data, including payment link if applicable.

methods.name: getTeam
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific team by ID, accessible to team members.

methods.name: getTeams
methods.description: Retrieves a list of teams associated with the current user.

methods.name: updateTeam
methods.description: Updates an existing team identified by ID with provided data.

methods.name: deleteTeam
methods.description: Deletes a team by ID, with rate limiting applied.
